title: SPX credit floor rejects 34 of 35 Beta signals
detail: Measured net of $0.10 slippage, a 5-wide 0.10-0.15 delta spread lands just under 0.85 x |delta| x width, and wider wings fail by more because credit/width falls with width. Beta also produces only 35 SPX signals in 176 days (SPX has no overnight session, so there are no overnight levels to sweep).
